_comment: Plane-4 standing tool-surface baseline (scripts/check-tool-surface.mjs). Growth is ALLOWED but never silent: raise a value and record `reason` + `recordedAt` saying what capability it buys. Dispatch-time caps are governed elsewhere and are not the subject of this baseline.

registry.toolDefinitions.reason: Policy pack (list/get/create/update/request_review): HR and policy coworkers must write DRAFT company policies into the Policy store for human review/publish on /compliance/policies — chat-only text was not durable. Five tools, draft-only write path; publish stays HITL.

registry.packFiles.reason: New policy-pack.ts owns company Policy draft lifecycle for coworkers (domain-owned pack, not more mega-module surface).

tier.coreToolNames.reason: Adds WWMD kernel discovery to core for peer CLIs (Grok/Codex): principle_decide + wiki_query. Those clients have no ToolSearch, so a lean core that omitted WWMD blocked AGENTS-required kernel consults even when the token already granted registry_read. Still lean vs full catalogue; authority stays grant/scope gated.
